title: Buyer quality
help: Out of 100 orders received (a customer sending the same order again counts once), how many came from real buyers: confirmed by an agent or delivered. The last {{count}} days are not finished: agents are still confirming.
noPrev: No earlier period to compare with yet: the trend shows soon.
none: Not enough finished orders to measure yet.
short: Choose 7 days or more: the last {{count}} days are not finished (agents are still confirming).

ads.title: Quality per ad
ads.help: For each ad (ad set): its orders, and on the finished days how many came from real buyers (confirmed or delivered) and how many were fake. The last {{count}} days do not count yet.
ads.none: No orders from an ad in this period. Add the URL parameters to your ads (Landing pages › Settings) to see them here.
ads.stop: think about changing its audience or stopping it
